properties.displayName: Web Session ASIM filtering parser for Cloudflare One
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime = datetime(null)
    , endtime:datetime = datetime(null)
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic = dynamic([])
    , ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic = dynamic([])
    , url_has_any:dynamic = dynamic([])
    , httpuseragent_has_any:dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventresultdetails_in:dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventresult:string = "*"
    , disabled:bool = false
    , pack:bool = false
)
{
    let CloudflareBase = (
        CloudflareV2_CL
        | where not(disabled)
        | where isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime
        | where isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated < endtime
        | extend
            EventOriginalType = case(
                // sinkhole_http_logs. SinkholeID is a unique field for sinkhole events
                isnotempty(SinkholeID)
                    and (
                        isnotempty(URL)
                        or isnotempty(URI)
                    )
                    , "sinkhole_http_logs"
                // gateway_http. Unique combination of available fields indicating gateway_http
                , (
                    isnotempty(RequestID)
                    or isnotempty(RegistrationID)
                )
                    and isnotempty(URL)
                    , "gateway_http"
                // firewall_events. Kind is a unique field for firewall events
                , isnotempty(ClientRequestPath)
                    and Kind =~ "firewall"
                    , "firewall_events"
                // http_requests. ClientRequestURI is a unique field for http_requests, also needed for Web Session
                , isnotempty(ClientRequestURI)
                    , "http_requests"
                , ""
            )
        | where EventOriginalType in (
            "gateway_http"
            , "http_requests"
            , "firewall_events"
            , "sinkhole_http_logs"
        )
    );
    let GatewayHttp = (
        CloudflareBase
        | where EventOriginalType == "gateway_http"
        | extend
            EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(Datetime), TimeGenerated)
            , SrcIpAddr = SourceIP
            , SrcPortNumber = toint(SourcePort)
            , DstIpAddr = DestinationIP
            , DstPortNumber = toint(DestinationPort)
            , Url = URL
            , HttpHost = HTTPHost
            , HttpRequestMethod = HTTPMethod
            , tmpHttpVersion = HTTPVersion
            , HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
            , HttpReferrer = Referer
            , tmpHttpCode = toint(HTTPStatusCode)
            , DvcOriginalAction = Action
            , EventOriginalUid = coalesce(RequestID, SessionID)
            , EventType = "HTTPsession"
            , SrcUsername = Email
            , RuleName = PolicyName
            , UrlCategory = iff(
                array_length(todynamic(CategoryNames)) > 0
                , strcat_array(todynamic(CategoryNames), ", ")
                , ""
            )
        | extend
            EventEndTime = EventStartTime
            , AdditionalFields = iff(pack
                , bag_pack(
                     "ApplicationNames", ApplicationNames
                    , "SourceIPCountryCode", SourceIPCountryCode
                    , "DestinationIPCountryCode", DestinationIPCountryCode
                    , "DeviceID", DeviceID
                    , "DeviceName", DeviceName
                    , "FileInfo", FileInfo
                    , "ProxyEndpoint", ProxyEndpoint
                    , "RegistrationID", RegistrationID
                    , "SourceInternalIP", SourceInternalIP
                    , "RequestID", RequestID
                    , "SessionID", SessionID
                    , "UserID", UserID
                    , "VirtualNetworkID", VirtualNetworkID
                    , "VirtualNetworkName", VirtualNetworkName
                    , "IsIsolated", IsIsolated
                    , "Quarantined", Quarantined
                    , "RedirectTargetURI", RedirectTargetURI
                    , "UntrustedCertificateAction", UntrustedCertificateAction
                    , "BlockedFileHash", BlockedFileHash
                    , "BlockedFileName", BlockedFileName
                    , "BlockedFileReason", BlockedFileReason
                    , "DownloadedFileNames", DownloadedFileNames
                    , "UploadedFileNames", UploadedFileNames
                    , "DownloadMatchedDlpProfiles", DownloadMatchedDlpProfiles
                    , "UploadMatchedDlpProfiles", UploadMatchedDlpProfiles
                )
                , dynamic({})
            )
    );
    let HttpRequests = (
        CloudflareBase
        | where EventOriginalType == "http_requests"
        | extend
            EventStartTime = coalesce(
                todatetime(EdgeStartTimestamp)
                , todatetime(Datetime)
                , TimeGenerated
            )
            , SrcIpAddr = ClientIP
            , SrcPortNumber = toint(ClientSrcPort)
            , DstIpAddr = OriginIP
            , DstPortNumber = toint(OriginPort)
            , Url = ClientRequestURI
            , HttpHost = ClientRequestHost
            , HttpRequestMethod = ClientRequestMethod
            , tmpHttpVersion = ClientRequestProtocol
            , HttpUserAgent = ClientRequestUserAgent
            , HttpReferrer = ClientRequestReferer
            , tmpHttpCode = case(
                toint(EdgeResponseStatus) > 0, toint(EdgeResponseStatus)
                , toint(OriginResponseStatus) > 0, toint(OriginResponseStatus)
                , int(null)
            )
            , DvcOriginalAction = SecurityAction
            , EventOriginalUid = RayID
            , EventType = "WebServerSession"
            , SrcUsername = ""
            , RuleName = SecurityRuleDescription
            , UrlCategory = ""
        | extend
            EventEndTime = coalesce(todatetime(EdgeEndTimestamp), EventStartTime)
            , AdditionalFields = iff(
                pack
                , bag_pack(
                     "SecurityActions", SecurityActions
                    , "SecurityRuleIDs", SecurityRuleIDs
                    , "SecuritySources", SecuritySources
                    , "WAFAttackScore", WAFAttackScore
                    , "WAFRCEAttackScore", WAFRCEAttackScore
                    , "WAFSQLiAttackScore", WAFSQLiAttackScore
                    , "WAFXSSAttackScore", WAFXSSAttackScore
                    , "BotScore", BotScore
                    , "BotScoreSrc", BotScoreSrc
                    , "BotTags", BotTags
                    , "Cookies", Cookies
                    , "BotDetectionTags", BotDetectionTags
                    , "BotDetectionIDs", BotDetectionIDs
                    , "JA3Hash", JA3Hash
                    , "JA4", JA4
                    , "LeakedCredentialCheckResult", LeakedCredentialCheckResult
                    , "ContentScanObjResults", ContentScanObjResults
                    , "ContentScanObjTypes", ContentScanObjTypes
                    , "RequestHeaders", RequestHeaders
                    , "CacheCacheStatus", CacheCacheStatus
                    , "ClientCountry", ClientCountry
                    , "ClientCity", ClientCity
                    , "ClientRegionCode", ClientRegionCode
                    , "ClientIPClass", ClientIPClass
                    , "ClientSSLProtocol", ClientSSLProtocol
                    , "ClientXRequestedWith", ClientXRequestedWith
                    , "ClientMTLSAuthStatus", ClientMTLSAuthStatus
                    , "ClientMTLSAuthCertFingerprint", ClientMTLSAuthCertFingerprint
                    , "EdgeRequestHost", EdgeRequestHost
                    , "EdgeResponseContentType", EdgeResponseContentType
                    , "EdgeColoCode", EdgeColoCode
                    , "EdgePathingOp", EdgePathingOp
                    , "EdgePathingSrc", EdgePathingSrc
                    , "EdgePathingStatus", EdgePathingStatus
                    , "EdgeServerIP", EdgeServerIP
                    , "OriginResponseStatus", OriginResponseStatus
                    , "OriginSSLProtocol", OriginSSLProtocol
                    , "ZoneName", ZoneName
                    , "WorkerScriptName", WorkerScriptName
                )
                , dynamic({})
            )
    );
    let FirewallEvents = (
        CloudflareBase
        | where EventOriginalType == "firewall_events"
        | extend
            EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(Datetime), TimeGenerated)
            , SrcIpAddr = ClientIP
            , SrcPortNumber = toint(ClientSrcPort)
            , DstIpAddr = OriginIP
            , DstPortNumber = toint(OriginPort)
            , Url = strcat(ClientRequestPath, ClientRequestQuery)
            , HttpHost = ClientRequestHost
            , HttpRequestMethod = ClientRequestMethod
            , tmpHttpVersion = ClientRequestProtocol
            , HttpUserAgent = ClientRequestUserAgent
            , HttpReferrer = iff(
                isempty(ClientRefererHost), ""
                , strcat(
                    ClientRefererScheme, "://"
                    , ClientRefererHost
                    , ClientRefererPath
                    , ClientRefererQuery
                )
            )
            , tmpHttpCode = case(
                toint(EdgeResponseStatus) > 0, toint(EdgeResponseStatus)
                , toint(OriginResponseStatus) > 0, toint(OriginResponseStatus)
                , int(null)
            )
            , DvcOriginalAction = Action
            , EventOriginalUid = RayID
            , EventType = "WebServerSession"
            , SrcUsername = ""
            , RuleName = Description
            , UrlCategory = ""
        | extend
            EventEndTime = EventStartTime
            , AdditionalFields = iff(
                pack
                , bag_pack(
                      "Ref", Ref
                    , "RuleID", RuleID
                    , "Source", Source
                    , "MatchIndex", MatchIndex
                    , "Metadata", Metadata
                    , "LeakedCredentialCheckResult", LeakedCredentialCheckResult
                    , "ContentScanObjResults", ContentScanObjResults
                    , "ContentScanObjTypes", ContentScanObjTypes
                    , "ClientCountry", ClientCountry
                    , "EdgeColoCode", EdgeColoCode
                    , "OriginResponseStatus", OriginResponseStatus
                    , "RayID", RayID
                    , "OriginatorRayID", OriginatorRayID
                    , "ZoneName", ZoneName
                )
                , dynamic({})
            )
    );
    let SinkholeHttp = (
        CloudflareBase
        | where EventOriginalType == "sinkhole_http_logs"
        | extend
            EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(Timestamp), TimeGenerated)
            , SrcIpAddr = SrcAddr
            , SrcPortNumber = int(null)
            , DstIpAddr = DestAddr
            , DstPortNumber = int(null)
            , Url = case(
                isnotempty(URI), URI
                , URL
            )
            , HttpHost = Host
            , HttpRequestMethod = Method
            , tmpHttpVersion = ""
            , HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
            , HttpReferrer = Referrer
            , tmpHttpCode = int(null)
            , DvcOriginalAction = ""
            , EventOriginalUid = SinkholeID
            , EventType = "WebServerSession"
            , SrcUsername = Username
            , RuleName = ""
            , UrlCategory = ""
        | extend
            EventEndTime = EventStartTime
            , AdditionalFields = iff(
                pack
                , bag_pack(
                     "AccountID", AccountID
                    , "Body", Body
                    , "BodyLength", BodyLength
                    , "Headers", Headers
                    , "R2Path", R2Path
                )
                , dynamic({})
            )
    );
    union
        GatewayHttp, HttpRequests, FirewallEvents, SinkholeHttp
    | where array_length(url_has_any) == 0
        or Url has_any (url_has_any)
    | where array_length(httpuseragent_has_any) == 0
        or HttpUserAgent has_any (httpuseragent_has_any)
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
        or ipv6_is_in_any_range(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | extend
        tmpSrcIpMatch = array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) > 0
            and (
                has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
                or ipv6_is_in_any_range(SrcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
            )
        , tmpDstIpMatch = array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) > 0
            and (
                has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
                or ipv6_is_in_any_range(DstIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
            )
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or tmpSrcIpMatch
        or tmpDstIpMatch
    | extend
          EventProduct = "Cloudflare One"
        , HttpVersion = case(
            isempty(tmpHttpVersion), ""
            , tmpHttpVersion in~ ("HTTP/2", "HTTP/2.0", "2", "2.0"), "2.0"
            , tmpHttpVersion in~ ("HTTP/3", "HTTP/3.0", "3", "3.0"), "3.0"
            , tmpHttpVersion startswith "HTTP/", substring(tmpHttpVersion, 5)
            , tmpHttpVersion
        )
        , DvcAction = case(
            DvcOriginalAction in~ (
                "allow" // gateway_http, http_requests, firewall_events
                , "isolate" // gateway_http
                , "override" // gateway_http
                , "safesearch" // gateway_http
                , "scan" // gateway_http
                , "noscan" // gateway_http
                , "redirect" // gateway_http
                , "bypass" // gateway_http, http_requests, firewall_events
                , "log" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "skip" // http_requests
                , "rewrite" // http_requests
                , "challengesolved" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "challengebypassed" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "jschallengesolved" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "jschallengebypassed" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "managedchallengenoninteractivesolved" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "managedchallengeinteractivesolved" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "managedchallengebypassed" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "precursorinterstitialpagebypassed" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "precursorinterstitialpagesolved" // http_requests, firewall_events
            )
                , "Allow"
            , DvcOriginalAction in~ (
                "block" // gateway_http, http_requests, firewall_events
                , "quarantine" // gateway_http
                , "challenge" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "jschallenge" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "managedchallenge" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "precursorinterstitialpageissued" // http_requests, firewall_events
            )
                , "Deny"
            , DvcOriginalAction in~ (
                "connectionclose" // http_requests, firewall_events
                , "forceconnectionclose" // http_requests
            )
                , "Drop"
            , ""
        )
        , EventResultDetails = iff(
            isnotnull(tmpHttpCode) and tmpHttpCode > 0
            , tostring(tmpHttpCode)
            , ""
        )
    | extend
        // Deny, Drop = Low; otherwise Informational.
        EventSeverity = iff(
            DvcAction in ("Deny", "Drop")
            , "Low"
            , "Informational"
        )
        , EventResult = case(
            // Success: <400, Failure: >=400
            DvcAction in ("Deny", "Drop")
                , "Failure"
            , isnotnull(tmpHttpCode) and tmpHttpCode >= 100 and tmpHttpCode < 400
                , "Success"
            , isnotnull(tmpHttpCode) and tmpHttpCode >= 400
                , "Failure"
            , DvcAction == "Allow"
                , "Success"
            , "NA"
        )
    | where eventresult == "*"
        or EventResult =~ eventresult
    | where array_length(eventresultdetails_in) == 0
        or EventResultDetails in~ (eventresultdetails_in)
    | extend
        SrcUsernameType = case(
            SrcUsername contains "@", "UPN"
            , SrcUsername contains @"\", "Windows"
            , isnotempty(SrcUsername), "Simple"
            , ""
        )
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , EventCount = int(1)
        , EventVendor = "Cloudflare"
        , EventSchema = "WebSession"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "0.2.7"
        , Dvc = EventProduct
        , ASimMatchingIpAddr = case(
            tmpSrcIpMatch and tmpDstIpMatch, "Both"
            , tmpSrcIpMatch, "SrcIpAddr"
            , tmpDstIpMatch, "DstIpAddr"
            , ""
        )
    | extend
        Src = SrcIpAddr
        , Dst = case(
            isnotempty(DstIpAddr), DstIpAddr
            , isnotempty(HttpHost), HttpHost
            , ""
        )
        , IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
        , User = SrcUsername
        , Rule = RuleName
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , Type
        , EventCount
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime
        , EventType
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventResult
        , EventResultDetails
        , HttpStatusCode = EventResultDetails
        , EventSeverity
        , EventProduct
        , EventVendor
        , EventSchema
        , EventSchemaVersion
        , EventUid
        , EventOriginalUid
        , Dvc
        , DvcAction
        , DvcOriginalAction
        , Src
        , SrcIpAddr
        , SrcPortNumber
        , SrcUsername
        , SrcUsernameType
        , Dst
        , DstIpAddr
        , DstPortNumber
        , IpAddr
        , User
        , Url
        , UrlCategory
        , HttpRequestMethod
        , HttpVersion
        , HttpHost
        , HttpReferrer
        , HttpUserAgent
        , Rule
        , RuleName
        , AdditionalFields
        , ASimMatchingIpAddr
};
parser(
    starttime = starttime
    , endtime = endtime
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix = srcipaddr_has_any_prefix
    , ipaddr_has_any_prefix = ipaddr_has_any_prefix
    , url_has_any = url_has_any
    , httpuseragent_has_any = httpuseragent_has_any
    , eventresultdetails_in = eventresultdetails_in
    , eventresult = eventresult
    , disabled = disabled
    , pack = pack
)
